pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Topological graph of thin, light-colored pathways forming a continuous network; junction nodes predominantly consist of tri-axial intersections with consistent pixel thickness across the visible neck surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, dark, elongated silhouette is positioned diagonally across the lower lateral neck, distinct from the primary pelage pattern.
